nodes.rule_text: An applicant for permission to stay who has lived in the UK with permission for 12 months or more meets the financial requirement and need not show funds.
For study in London, all other cases require outstanding course fees plus £1,529 for each course month, up to 9 months.
For study outside London, all other cases require outstanding course fees plus £1,171 for each course month, up to 9 months.
Required funds must be held for a 28-day period, as specified in Appendix Finance, subject to the stated sponsorship exceptions.
The most recently dated financial evidence must be dated within 31 days before the application date.
The funds-held period is calculated by counting back from the closing-balance date on the most recent evidence.
